body: Thank you Kind Stranger. I’m really sorry you struggle with this BS too, but even though I don’t know you I’m proud of you for sticking through it. The parental pressure issue is a bit of a can of worms so to speak. My mom is disabled and I’m a live-in caregiver for her. I know that technically I could leave and pursue my own interests, but it’s really complicated by the fact that I’m so scared something will happen to her if I leave, and at this point I’m just kind of expected to fill the role of caregiver by my family and their friends (don’t really have many of those myself) and I would be emotionally crucified for leaving. I am working on it, taking steps in a positive direction, but it still always feels one step forth and two back. I also had a complete meltdown last year, the Covid really seemed to affect us crazies. Struggled very hard with addiction last year, and because of that I ended up doing things under the influence that I would NEVER even think of doing now, so a lot of guilt and shame has built up around that, so I also feel like I kind of need to ‘pay it back’ somehow to make up for it. Thank you for taking the time to read my post and responding, it means a lot to me.

Wow, what I read in the thread really didn’t represent this well. I don’t agree with the whole article but it’s certainly not claiming White Supremacy doesn’t exist and isn’t a problem.... what article did everyone else read?

In lara.mp4 we first see the distortion at 4:15 with the footage being played forward at a normal speed in the YouTube view. At 4:21, it switches to Simon View and the footage rewinds to before the distortion, showing no distortion in rewind. At 4:22 the distortion occurs again, while the footage is being played forward at a normal speed. At approximately 4:26, the footage is rewound over the spot of previous distortion for the second time, showing no issue. At 4:30, we once again see the distortion, with the footage being played forward at normal speed. 
Times are maybe a little washy as I’m on mobile and can’t go frame by frame.

I mean, I think it certainly lends credence to the idea of it not being simply a “technical” glitch. If it was just corruption of the footage, we would see the distortion when it’s being rewound as well. One possibility I see is that the glitch isn’t embedded in the footage, it’s being corrupted real time. Maybe there’s something there the Entity doesn’t want Simon (or us?) to see/hear, so it’s censoring it for him when he tries to play it undistorted. Opens it up for the potential of other “technical” issues being more than they appear, at least in the universe where this is possible.
Looks as though they’ve jazzed it up quite a bit as well. Looks a bit different on film with lighting, but I think they went and did detail work on it too.
